_comment: Deterministic fixture for the plugin safety harness. Seeds the NCAA men's lacrosse season-schedule cache (key ncaa_mens_lacrosse_schedule_2026) with one final, one in-progress, and one scheduled game so recent/upcoming render real game cards without network access. Live mode is disabled: the live manager's _fetch_data() -> _fetch_todays_games() is a direct network call with no cache read and no test_mode passthrough in _adapt_config_for_manager, so the live screen can never be fed from mock data. The huge update_intervals.live keeps the always-instantiated live manager from attempting that doomed network fetch on every update() (under freeze_time, now - last_update stays below it), keeping CI runs fast.
